title: Who can come in? 127.0.0.1 vs 0.0.0.0
subtitle: The address a program listens on decides who can reach it: only the laptop itself, or anyone on the network.

notes.text:
127.0.0.1 = the intercom inside the building. Only people already inside can use it.

0.0.0.0 = the front door, open to the street. Anyone who knows the address can knock.

Docker's -p 8080:80 opens the front door (0.0.0.0). -p 127.0.0.1:8080:80 keeps it to the intercom.

python3 -m http.server 9003 --bind 127.0.0.1
python3 -m http.server 9004 --bind 0.0.0.0

# on your phone's browser:
http://192.168.1.23:9004   # works
http://192.168.1.23:9003   # can't connect
